name: paper-research
description: Interactive loopback literature research workflow for Codex with abstracts, citation counts, optional repository cloning, and optional paper artifact retrieval.

interface.shortDescription: Research papers, code links, and paper artifacts.
interface.longDescription: Installs repo-local Codex custom agent templates for an iterative literature research workflow with requirement collection, scope locking, paper discovery with abstracts and citation counts, citation-prioritized code verification, optional local repository cloning, optional paper PDF/TeX retrieval and TeX compilation, CSV output, and reviewer-driven loopback.
defaultPrompt: Research papers and include abstracts in the CSV.
Research papers with citation counts and code links.
Use my paper as a seed for literature research.
Research papers and clone verified code repositories.
Research papers and download PDFs or TeX sources.
